description_en: Updates the properties of a Logstore
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-log-store --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --logstore-name test-logstore --shard-count 2 --ttl 30 --encrypt-conf example-string --auto-split true --enable-tracking false --append-meta false --max-split-shard 64 --telemetry-type None --hot-ttl 60 --biz-mode standard --infrequent-access-ttl 30 --sharding-policy example-string --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en: The retention period of data in the hot tier of the Logstore. Minimum value: 7. Unit: days. Valid values: 7 to 3000. After the retention period of the hot tier ends, the data is moved to the Infrequent Access (IA) storage class. For more information, see [Automatic Storage Tiering](~~308645~~).
parameters.description_zh:
数据在Logstore热存储层中的存储时间。单位：天，最小为7，最大不能超过ttl的值，默认保存时间ttl内全是热存储。

当数据的存储时间超过您所配置的热存储层数据保存时间后，数据将转为低频存储（开启低频存储时，要求热存储时间至少为 7 天）。更多信息，请参见[智能冷热分层存储](~~308645~~)。

示例：
- 场景1 （只开启热存储 30天）：`{"ttl": 30}` 或者  `{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 30}`
- 场景2 （开启热存储7天，低频存储 23 天）: `{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 7}`
parameters.help_en: The retention period of data in the hot tier of the Logstore. Minimum value: 7. Unit: days. Valid values: 7 to 3000. After the retention period of the hot tier ends, the data is moved to the Infrequent Access (IA) storage class. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308645.html

parameters.name: hot_ttl

parameters.description_en:
SLS provides two types of Logstores: Standard and Query.

- **standard**: supports one-stop data analytics. This type of Logstore is suitable for scenarios such as real-time monitoring, interactive analysis, and building a complete observability system.

- **query**: supports high-performance queries. The index traffic cost of a Query Logstore is about half that of a Standard Logstore. However, a Query Logstore does not support SQL analysis. This type of Logstore is suitable for scenarios that involve large data volumes, long retention periods of weeks or months, and no log analysis.
parameters.description_zh:
日志服务提供标准型（Standard）和查询型（Query）两种类型的Logstore。

- **standard**：支持日志服务一站式数据分析功能，适用于实时监控、交互式分析以及构建完整的可观测性系统等场景。
- **query**：支持高性能查询，索引流量费用约为Standard的一半，但不支持SQL分析，适用于数据量大、存储周期长（周、月级别以上）、无日志分析的场景。

parameters.description_en: The retention period for data in the IA storage class. Data in this storage class has no minimum retention period. Data must be stored for at least 30 days before it is moved to Archive storage.
parameters.description_zh:
低频存储。没有最少存储时间要求，至少保存30天转归档存储。

当日志存储时间大于热存储时间与低频存储时间之和时，剩余的存储时间将转化为归档存储。

示例：
- 场景 1 （开启热存 7 天，低频存储 23 天）：`{"ttl": 30, "hot_ttl": 7}`
- 场景 2  （开启热存 7天，低频存储 30 天，归档 60 天）: `{"ttl": 97, "hot_ttl": 7, "infrequentAccessTTL": 30}`
- 场景 3 （开启热存 60 天，低频存储 0 天，归档 60 天）: `{"ttl": 120, "hot_ttl": 60, "infrequentAccessTTL": 0}`
parameters.help_en: The retention period for data in the IA storage class. Data in this storage class has no minimum retention period. Data must be stored for at least 30 days before it is moved to Archive storage
